source_text:
2026-07 非农就业变动为 +21,000人。 [F1] 2026-08 非农就业变动为 +162,000人。 [F2] 2026-08 失业率为 4.1%。 [F3] 7 月非农就业数据从负值大幅修订至 +21,000 人，显示劳动力需求显著强劲，但 8 月 +162,000 人的增速虽高于前月，官方明确声明失业率保持 4.1% 不变，表明就业质量或劳动力参与率的变化未被当前数据证实。

2026-06 非农就业变动为 +31,000人。 [F4] 由于证据包仅包含部分数字，无法确认工资增长、劳动力参与率或行业细节，因此不能断言就业改善是真实且全面的，仅凭单月数据推断政策预期已过度乐观缺乏充分依据。

 接下来需要检查工资增长、劳动力参与率及行业细分数据，以验证就业质量是否真实改善，同时避免将单月修订后的数字直接等同于政策决策或公司业绩。
translated_text:
In July 2026, nonfarm payrolls changed by +21,000. [F1] In August 2026, nonfarm payrolls changed by +162,000. [F2] In August 2026, the unemployment rate was 4.1%. [F3] The July nonfarm payroll data was revised significantly from a negative value to +21,000, indicating notably strong labor demand; however, although the August +162,000 increase was higher than the previous month, the official statement that the unemployment rate remained at 4.1% suggests that changes in employment quality or labor participation rates are not confirmed by the current data.

In June 2026, nonfarm payrolls changed by +31,000. [F4] Since the evidence package contains only partial figures, it is impossible to confirm wage growth, labor participation rates, or industry details; therefore, asserting that employment improvement is real and comprehensive based solely on single-month data lacks sufficient basis, and policy expectations derived from such data are overly optimistic.

Next, it is necessary to examine wage growth, labor participation rates, and industry sub-sector data to verify whether employment quality has genuinely improved, while avoiding equating revised single-month figures directly with policy decisions or company performance.
